title: Zero-downtime schema migrations
body: Plan compatible schema changes, deploy readers first, and backfill data without interrupting production traffic.

title: Vector search tuning
body: Tune nearest-neighbor retrieval by separating the number of returned results from the candidate pool and reranking window.

title: SolrCloud backup operations
body: Create collection backups, verify repository configuration, and test restore procedures before an incident.

title: Reliable API deployments
body: Use health checks, gradual rollouts, and rollback automation to reduce downtime during application releases.
